mappings.note: The translation starts with the title 'Au maître-chantre. Psaume de David.' which corresponds to OSMAIN v1's title, but the translation splits this title into its own verse (v1), leaving the actual text of OSMAIN v1 ('For korlederen...') to start at Translation v2.
Translation v2 contains the text of OSMAIN v1 ('Que l'Éternel te réponde...'), but misses the title which was moved to Translation v1.
Matches OSMAIN v2 perfectly in content and structure.
Matches OSMAIN v3 ('Qu'il se souvienne... Sélah') perfectly.
Matches OSMAIN v6 ('Déjà je sais...') perfectly.
Matches OSMAIN v7 ('Les uns se vantent...') perfectly.
Matches OSMAIN v8 ('Ils ont plié...') perfectly.

Translation v10 corresponds to OSMAIN v9. However, there is a significant difference in the address: Translation says 'sauve le roi' (save the king), while OSMAIN says 'HERRE, frels oss!' (Lord, save us!). The translation adds specific content ('le roi') not present in the source text.

extraContent.description: The phrase 'sauve le roi' (save the king) appears in Translation v10. The corresponding OSMAIN v9 says 'HERRE, frels oss!' (Lord, save us!). The translation has inserted 'the king' where the source text said 'us'. This is an addition of specific content not found in the OSMAIN text.
